candidates.formal_type:
∀ (ρ : Q₂Rep.{0, uV, uW} Complex),
  Not (IsNilpotent.{uW} (LinearMap.comp.{0, 0, 0, uW, uV, uW} (Q₂Rep.A.{0, uV, uW} ρ) (Q₂Rep.B.{0, uV, uW} ρ))) →
    Exists.{1} fun n =>
      Exists.{0} fun hn =>
        Exists.{1} fun lam =>
          And (Ne.{1} lam 0)
            (Exists.{max (uV + 2) (uW + 2)} fun τ =>
              And (Nonempty.{max (uV + 1) (uW + 1)} (Q₂Rep.SplitEmbedding.{uV, uW, uV, uW} τ ρ))
                (Nonempty.{max (max (uV + 1) (uW + 1)) 1} (Q₂Rep.Iso.{0, uV, uW, 0, 0} τ (Etingof.Q₂Rep_E n hn lam))))
